The LEFT_DELIM_JOIN (node 5) implements the NOT IN anti-join; because RatecodeID is nullable, the engine cannot use a simple hash anti-join and must perform per-row null checks, adding significant overhead.

The SEQ_SCAN on zones (node 6) is small (265 rows), but if the LEFT_DELIM_JOIN is executed as a correlated nested loop rather than a hash anti-join, it could cause repeated execution of the subquery; however, the plan suggests a hash join is used, so this is less likely.
